idea-plugin.name: Find Instance Creations
idea-plugin.description: Finds usages of the Scala class under the caret restricted to instance creation - constructor calls and a case class's generated apply - in production sources only. Equivalent to the Scala plugin's "Instance creation only" checkbox plus a Production scope, with no dialog, so it can be bound to a key.

action.description: Find production usages of the class under the caret, restricted to instance creation
